name: Oriq
description: The Oriq are a secret society of masked mages on Arcavios who use forbidden magic and sought to destroy Strixhaven.

description_citations.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

summary.text: The Oriq are a secret society of masked mages on Arcavios who use forbidden magic and sought to destroy Strixhaven.

citations.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

bio.text: Extus Narr took control of the Oriq with a lethal strike and sought vengeance, having infiltrators recruit promising students from the halls he wanted to destroy.

bio.text: Oriq agents stole from Strixhaven, captured Lukka and Zimone's grandmother Nimiroti, and later captured Zimone herself.

timeline.summary: Liliana catches a masked intruder stealing books, who strikes her arm with a sickening spell.
timeline.quote: The words fell away as a streak of purplish light flew from the figure's hand.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana identifies the intruder as one of the Oriq, who warns her that her days are numbered.
timeline.quote: Then you know that your days are numbered.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Masked Oriq mages ambush Lukka and Mila in a desert and take Lukka prisoner.
timeline.quote: Slowly, he raised his hands in surrender.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: In the cave Lukka senses shelled creatures hanging around them.
timeline.quote: Slowly, whatever it was seemed to unfold, stretching long and spindly legs into the darkness.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Villagers accuse Lukka of being an Oriq recruiter and threaten him.
timeline.quote: Okay, Oriq, I think I've heard enough.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana returns empty-handed from Caerdoon and runs into Oriq agents capturing a white stag.
timeline.quote: Liliana pressed against the gnarled trunk of an old tree and watched as the band of Oriq agents surrounded a large white stag.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka watches a Dragonsguard confront masked Oriq agents.
timeline.quote: he could see a woman wearing immaculate robes facing a group of masked individuals

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The Dragonsguard reflects an Oriq curse that nearly hits Lukka and rots a tree.
timeline.quote: He ducked just in time, the spell hissing horribly as it flew overhead and hit a tree to his right.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus broods over Oriq agents drained of life for the ritual, which still was not enough.
timeline.quote: every last bit of life drained from their bodies, and it wasn't enough

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx warns the twins about the Oriq and hints Strixhaven does not hold all power on the plane, leaving Will suspecting she is a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Strixhaven doesn't have a monopoly on power in this plane.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina's owl sees a masked Oriq agent offer Lukka a silver skull mask, which he refuses.
timeline.quote: It was a silver mask, shaped like a human skull.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus orders the Oriq to attack as Lukka controls the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: Commence the attack.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will wakes to learn from Wickel that the Oriq are attacking.
timeline.quote: The Oriq are here

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana reflects an Oriq life-draining spell back onto its caster, killing him.
timeline.quote: With a gesture, Liliana sent it racing back toward the caster, twice as hungry as before.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx kills an Oriq agent aiming at the twins.
timeline.quote: When she opened them, she saw the Oriq splayed across the ground.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx explains Extus leads the Oriq and is responsible for the attack.
timeline.quote: The man responsible for all of this. The leader of the Oriq.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Oriq agents arrange books and scrolls, and Extus begins to read the ritual.
timeline.quote: Extus began to read.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The twins zap and ice-bind Oriq agents as Liliana leads them to the Snarl.
timeline.quote: at the first sign of one of the masked Oriq, Rowan would zap them with a current of energy that left them twitching on the ground

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan blasts a group of Oriq with lightning, and Liliana pushes the soul out of an agent threatening her.
timeline.quote: With a savage thrust of will, she pushed it free of his body, which dropped in a heap on the floor.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Freed mage hunters turn on the nearest Oriq agents.
timeline.quote: turned on the nearest source of magical sustenance: Oriq agents

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina sees Lukka wandering with Mila and remaining Oriq, but turns her attention to the twins.
timeline.quote: But he was no longer worth watching.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kianne says Imbraham egged Nimiroti on until the Oriq got hold of her.
timeline.quote: egged her on until the Oriq got hold of her

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The Codex Vocifera tells Zimone that Nimiroti solved the Vorzani Conjecture and was captured by the Oriq.
timeline.quote: Nimiroti figured out the Vorzani Conjecture.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus, seeking vengeance, has infiltrators recruit promising mage-students from the halls he sought to destroy.
timeline.quote: His infiltrators recruited promising mage-students from the very halls he sought to destroy.

citation.text: Tempted by the Oriq (Strixhaven: School of Mages Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Extus takes control of the Oriq with a lethal strike, his first step toward vengeance.
timeline.quote: With one lethal strike, Extus took control of the Oriq and took his first step towards vengeance.

citation.text: Rise of Extus (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Oriq take notice of Zimone's brilliance.
timeline.quote: Zimone's brilliance drew attention from many, including the sinister mages known as the Oriq.

citation.text: Solve the Equation (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Oriq are defeated by a coalition of professors and planeswalkers led by Professor Vess.
timeline.quote: The Oriq were defeated by a coalition of Professors and Planeswalkers under the leadership of Professor Vess.

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Rise of the Oriq". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Killian is tempted by an Oriq agent and drinks a potion that shuts out empathy, then learns white magic with Doco's help and wins his father's approval.
timeline.quote: he just in time learned to use white magic

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana leads the confrontation with the Oriq.
timeline.quote: She took the lead in the confrontation with the Oriq

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "On Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Arcavios Lukka bonds with Mila, is captured by the Oriq and meets their leader Extus Narr, who offers a trade.
timeline.quote: Extus explained that there were things he could teach Lukka and proposed a trade.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka helps the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating an attack on Strixhaven, then leaves when the Founder Dragons turn the tide.
timeline.quote: when the tide was turned by the Founder Dragons , Lukka quickly left the battlefield

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers and Strixhaven's residents are confronted by the Oriq.
timeline.quote: They are confronted by the Oriq .

citation.text: "Strixhaven: School of Mages", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zimone's grandmother Nimiroti had solved the Vorzani Conjecture and was captured by the Oriq, then cast a memory-loss spell on herself.
timeline.quote: Nimiroti had to cast a memory loss spell on herself to erase her knowledge of the Conjecture from her mind

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Captured by the Oriq". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Oriq capture Zimone, and Extus Narr wants her knowledge; Zimone rescues him when Kianne and her friends come, showing she has mastered time and space.
timeline.quote: she demonstrated that she had mastered time and space, and thus had solved the Vorzani Conjecture

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Captured by the Oriq". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Embrose rejects light magic and tells Killian Oriq hearts must be broken.
timeline.quote: Oriq hearts do not bend in battle; mage hunter souls are never mended.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Fannessa reveals herself as an Oriq agent in armor and offers a mask.
timeline.quote: Fannessa too became engulfed in purple flames that burned her Silverquill robes away, revealing jagged, gray Oriq armor underneath.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Tamira explains that underclassmen may only now visit remote sites because the Oriq have been driven back.
timeline.quote: Now that the Oriq are effectively gone, we can reopen more remote locations for scholarship.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra says she must make sure Ajani has not been compromised, and Lluwen reveals the masked figures are Oriq.
timeline.quote: They're the Oriq.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra Nalaar joins a group of reformed Oriq while an alternate form of Ral Zarek causes trouble.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar joins up with a group of reformed Oriq

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After a rumor Zimone joined the Oriq, Amaka and Nnanyielugo began avoiding her.
timeline.quote: Amaka and Nnanyielugo began avoiding Zimone when they saw her at the Biblioplex.

citation.text: "Amaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Extus takes control of the Oriq and seeks vengeance, trying to awaken the Blood Avatar.
timeline.quote: he took control of the Oriq and began his path for vengeance

citation.text: "Extus Narr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka helps the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating a mage hunter attack on Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Lukka helped the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating a mage hunter attack on Strixhaven.

citation.text: "Extus Narr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka helps the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating a Mage Hunter attack on Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Lukka helped the Oriq by distracting Kasmina

citation.text: "Oriq", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: By 4564 AR the Oriq are considered effectively gone.
timeline.quote: By 4564 AR , the Oriq were considered "effectively gone".

citation.text: "Oriq", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oriq forces led by Extus Narr attacked Strixhaven with Mage Hunters.
timeline.quote: the Strixhaven campus in Arcavios was subjected to a large-scale assault by Oriq forces led by Extus Narr

citation.text: "Oriq attack on Strixhaven", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The students and Ajani Goldmane investigate and come into conflict with Chandra Nalaar and renegade former Oriq.
timeline.quote: brought them into conflict with Chandra Nalaar and a renegade group of former Oriq

citation.text: "Titan's Grave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
